subject: Attack-surface mapping + evidence ask for ISO/FedRAMP intake
messages:
From: audits@bluewave-sec.com
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intake: attack-surface mapping + evidence list for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of CityBank's procurement and BlueWave's assessment, we need a short (high-level) attack-surface mapping and a prioritized evidence list tied to the service boundary. Ideally we can get the first pass by EOD Thu so we can confirm scope for the pre-audit dry run.

Requested deliverables (first-pass):
- One-page service boundary summary (who/what/where data flows)
- Inventory of endpoints and external integrations (SaaS, cloud providers, vendor connections)
- Prioritized evidence list for controls in scope (logs, config snapshots, user access lists) — mark what exists vs. needed
- Any regional data residency notes or cross-region backups

Do you have a recommended point person on infra/network to own the network diagram and logs extract? We can also accept staged deliverables (inventory first, diagrams next).

Regards,
Amit Rao
BlueWave Security (technical lead)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: audits@bluewave-sec.com, sarah.hall@citybank.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-11T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: attack-surface mapping + evidence list for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Amit / Sarah — thanks, we can take this on. Quick proposal for cadence and owners: 

- Inventory & prioritized evidence list: I (Diego) will turn up an initial sheet by 2026-10-13 18:00 PT (attached as evidence_inventory_v0.3).
- Service boundary one-pager: Kimberly will draft the first pass by 2026-10-14.
- Network/zone diagram and log extraction: Marcus will own the diagram and provide a sanitized logs extraction plan by 2026-10-15.

Quick notes on scope assumptions (please flag if CityBank requires additional scope):
- We are mapping the Redwood inference hosted API surfaces plus Dedicated connector endpoints; we will exclude internal CI/CD ephemeral runners unless explicitly requested.
- Data classification: only customer request payloads and model artifacts are in-scope for the first pass; internal telemetry and anonymized metrics will be documented but not sampled unless requested.

Attachments included: evidence_inventory_v0.3.xlsx (initial inventory, marked EXISTING / NEEDS). Marcus — can you upload the zone diagram stub and a short note on where shard-level logs live? Kimberly — will start the boundary one-pager and include KMS/HSM notes.

Diego
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai, audits@bluewave-sec.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-12T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: attack-surface mapping + evidence list for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Diego / Amit — quick clarifications from product/security before we lock the inventory: 

- Please mark any dedicated-customer VPC endpoints and private deployment connectors as HIGH priority for evidence (we frequently see extra controls called out there).
- For logs: BlueWave — we will provide an example logs bundle (sanitized) and a documented retention snapshot (where and how we pull). Are you expecting full raw logs or pre-filtered audit trails?
- For CAIQ/SIG correlation — I will annotate the inventory rows with the likely questionnaire mappings (control IDs) so the first pass helps the questionnaire teams.

I will attach a short template for the one-pager and include KMS rotation cadence + HSM attestations. Marcus — ping me the diagram draft and I’ll overlay control boundaries.

-Kimberly
Head of Product Security
Redwood Inference
From: Amit Rao <audits@bluewave-sec.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: sarah.hall@citybank.com
Date: 2026-10-13T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: attack-surface mapping + evidence list for upcoming ISO/FedRAMP scoping

Diego / Kimberly — thanks for the plan. A couple quick follow-ups before the dry run scheduling:

- Logs: we need an unfiltered audit trail for the control families related to access (authn/authz) and API request/response headers for a 72-hour sample window. A sanitized bundle is fine; please document the sanitization steps.
- Evidence priority: tag anything that demonstrates configuration hardening (CIS-like baseline), KMS/HSM key rotation proof, and SOC2 audit logs with HIGH priority.
- Timeline: once we have the inventory and the one-pager, BlueWave will produce a scoped questionnaire tailored to CityBank's procurement (SIG + targeted CAIQ sections). Please aim to seed anything labelled HIGH by 2026-10-15 so we can keep the dry-run in the week of 2026-10-19.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min triage call tomorrow to review the inventory schema and the log extraction approach.

Thanks,
Amit Rao
BlueWave Security
